headline: Trilegal advises GRT Jewellers on ₹1,034 crore stake acquisition in TBZ
sum: GRT Jewellers India Private Limited is set to acquire 74.12% of Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited (TBZ) from its promoters and members of the promoter group for ₹1,034 crore. Trilegal advised GRT Jewellers on this transaction.
detail: GRT Jewellers India Private Limited is set to acquire 74.12% of Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited (TBZ) from its promoters and members of the promoter group for ₹1,034 crore. Trilegal advised GRT Jewellers on this transaction. The transaction was led by Ashwyn Misra (Partner) and Deep Choudhuri (Partner), with assistance from Teeshta Bissa (Senior Associate), Jatin Sharma (Senior Associate), Associates Anuraag Pillai, Shubhangi Singh, Niti Gosrani, Rohit Krishna, and Anthara N. The following provided support: Employment team: Kanishka Maggon (Partner), Abhijeet Singh (Associate).
